prompts:
Use case: productivity-visual. Generate ONE complete second slide for the Sachet financial safety pitch deck. Landscape 16:9 flat presentation artwork, high resolution, clear accurate English text, polished white minimal design consistent with accepted cover: dark ink typography, muted orange emphasis, thin borders, numbered workflow panels, subtle soft shadows. This slide must feel substantial and informative, not empty. Fill roughly 70-80% of useful canvas with organized content, keep readable margins. Use good amounts of readable text, not tiny dense paragraphs. NO photographs, no huge generic shield, no member names, no fabricated statistics, no scenario label, no watermarks. Header exact "The danger becomes clear as the conversation unfolds." Small eyebrow "02 / THE PROBLEM". Footer exact "Sachet · Team ANKOR" and "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2".
Include a three-stage example progression:
01 BUILD TRUST
"Your investment balance is ready."
"Plausible claims create confidence before any risky request appears."
02 INTRODUCE A CONDITION
"Pay a processing fee to withdraw."
"The promised benefit becomes dependent on an additional payment."
03 PUSH FOR ACTION
"Transfer now to avoid losing access."
"Urgency narrows the time available for independent verification."
Include three real user challenges with simple icons and exact headings plus body:
"Fragmented context" — "Messages, calls and payment requests can appear on separate screens. A single message may miss the developing pattern."
"Pressure to act" — "The user must decide whether to pay while the sender discourages delay or verification."
"Warning fatigue" — "Repeated, vague alerts compete for attention. Useful warnings need a specific reason and a practical next step."
Concluding emphasis exact "Recognize the risky sequence. Explain the evidence. Warn at the right moment."
Preserve typography hierarchy and good spelling. Every stage and challenge must be readable.
LAYOUT A: Editorial structured two-band layout. Header top-left, small orange line beneath. Upper-middle three horizontal rectangular numbered stage panels linked by thin gray arrows, with the transition to the third accented orange; large numbers, label, quoted message and short interpretation inside each panel. Lower-middle three aligned compact challenge cards with simple line icons of overlapping screens, clock, and bell; heading and full body copy each. Bottom a full-width warm orange-tinted conclusion strip. Avoid excessive empty space; title two lines max, flowchart is primary visual.
